questions.stem: A 32-year-old teacher from Mumbai attends a health workshop aimed at understanding the basics of health care systems. During a group discussion, she realizes that her perception of health care might be limited, basing it only on her experiences with hospitals and clinics. The facilitator of the workshop provides a series of statements to the attendees for further clarification.Which of the following statements is most incorrect regarding the concept of health care?

options.label: A
options.text: Medical care is synonymous with health care.

options.label: B
options.text: The purpose of health care is promoting, maintaining, monitoring, or restoring health.

options.label: C
options.text: Health care is a public right.

options.label: D
options.text: Medical care range from domiciliary care to resident hospital care.
